Cookies on thewinesociety.com

Our website uses cookies to analyse traffic, personalise advertising & show you more of what’s relevant to you. Please let us know that you agree to all of our cookies. You can find out more on our cookies page at any time.

Cookies Settings Accept All Cookies

Privacy Preference Centre

We use cookies for a number of purposes including enabling easy navigation and shopping on the website, monitoring website performance and usage, serving personalised content to visitors and displaying targeted advertisements on social media. A cookie is a small text file that is placed on your device by a website server and which can then be read by the website server that placed it. Cookies allow websites to remember snippets of information. They can be used to enhance your experience on a website, for example by keeping you logged in when you navigate away from a website or keeping track of your shopping basket as you shop. They can also be used to provide useful information to the website owner, such as remembering pages you have visited in order to serve personalised content or advertisements. Before proceeding to browse our website, please use this tool to set your cookie preferences. For more information, please see our Cookie Policy and Privacy Policy. View our cookie policyAllow All

Manage Consent Preferences

Performance Cookies

These cookies allow us to recognise and count our website’s visitors, to see how visitors move around our website when they are using it and to monitor and improve the performance of our website. Information collected by these cookies is aggregated for statistical purposes and does not contain any personal data. For example: • Google Analytics – we use cookies for the Google Universal Analytics service (these may be called “_ga”, “_gali”, “_gat” and “_gid”). We use this information to compile analytics reports and to help us improve the website.

Targeting Cookies

These cookies are used to track your browsing behaviour and to display targeted advertisements to you on other websites based on the content you view on our site. The information collected by these cookies may be shared with third parties such as advertisers and they may use this to build a profile of your interests for the purposes of targeted advertisements. If you disable these cookies you will see generic ads rather than personalised ads on other sites. For example: • Facebook – we use a cookie which lets Facebook know what content you have viewed on our site, in order to display personalised ads to you on the Facebook platform. • YouTube – where we have YouTube videos embedded on our website, cookies may be placed which tracking your viewing activity in order to serve personalised ads or recommend other videos to you.

Strictly Necessary Cookies

Always Active

These cookies are necessary for the website to function properly and cannot be disabled in our cookie management tool. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site may not work correctly if these are blocked. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information. For example: • OneTrust – we use a cookie to remember the preferences you set within our cookie consent tool, to comply with our obligations under e-privacy laws and to save your preferences for when you return to the site. • Shopping cart – we use a cookie to store the contents of your shopping cart when you’re navigating our website.

Functional Cookies

These cookies are used to support certain functionality on the website or to remember preferences that you may set. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our website. For example: • Peerius – we use cookies for the Peerius service implemented on our website, which monitors visitor behaviour to enable us to serve up personalised content. • YouTube – where we have YouTube videos embedded on our website, cookies may be placed which enable the video to play correctly and to remember any preferences that you have set on the YouTube website.
